statement: A per-protocol result must be reported beside the intention-to-treat result, never alone.

Under inference, QRILC is refused for values below detection because it fills each value with a single draw outside the multiple imputation, so the intervals would not carry the imputation uncertainty.
claimed_basis: None cited beyond the reasoning; contract rung 'refused' (omics.py:1895).

statement: Under inference with repeated units, GEE with an exchangeable working correlation and the ordinary sandwich variance (CR0) with a normal reference gives near-nominal type I error even with about 12 units, so no small-sample correction of the sandwich is needed.
regime: inference with repeated rows per unit, about 12 units

statement: For NHANES data the correct survey weight is the weight of the smallest subsample on which all analysis variables were measured (the least common denominator): an OGTT analyte requires the OGTT subsample weight (WTSOG*), a fasting analyte (glucose, triglycerides, LDL, insulin, apoB) the fasting subsample weight (WTSAF*), dietary recall variables the day-1 dietary weight (WTDRD1*, or the two-day WTDR2D* when day-2 variables are present), and otherwise the MEC examination weight; a variable recorded only where a subsample weight is positive (at most 1% of its rows outside, missing on at least 5% of the table, at least 10 rows) is that subsample's variable whatever its name; that weight is offered first, then the weights of the samples that contain it.
regime: NHANES (2-year, pooled multi-cycle, 2017-March 2020 pre-pandemic) tables with weights and design columns.
decision: Which survey weight is offered first (Recommended) for design-based estimates.
claimed_basis: NHANES Tutorials, Weighting Module: "You must use the weight of the smallest subpopulation that includes all the variables you want to include in your analysis."; "A good rule of thumb is to use 'the least common denominator'..."; CDC codebook names (recognizers.py:1773-1812). SUBSAMPLE_SLACK/MIN_MISSING/MIN_ROWS are "TurboTab's own tolerance".

statement: An infinite value, typically a ratio over a zero denominator (such as protein per 1,000 kcal on a day recorded as 0 kcal), is not a measurement, and setting it to missing is the repair.

A column named as a percent of energy whose values all lie at or below 1 holds fractions rather than percentages, and values outside 0–100 are not percentages of energy, so either is refused before a percent-of-energy swap.
regime: percent-of-energy columns moved by a share swap
decision: whether the share swap can be computed

statement: A standard drink holds 8-20 g of ethanol depending on country (US 14 g per NIAAA; UK unit 8 g per NHS; 10 g the modal governmental size per Kalinowski & Humphreys 2016) and alcohol carries 7 kcal/g, so an alcohol column recorded in drinks moves 7 x (grams per drink) kcal per drink in a substitution, and drink sizes outside 8-20 g are not accepted.
regime: Dietary substitution involving alcohol recorded in standard drinks.
decision: kcal per unit for alcohol in drinks; offered drink sizes.
claimed_basis: NIAAA, NHS and Kalinowski & Humphreys 2016 quoted at readings.py:2253-2257.

statement: The between-site heterogeneity of a prediction model's performance is better conveyed by a 95% prediction interval for a new site, μ̂ ± t(k-2)·√(τ̂² + σ̂_μ²), than by I² (which can mislead when site sizes are large), so the prediction interval is said first, and it needs at least three sites.
claimed_basis: Riley et al. 2016 (BMJ 353:i3140); Higgins, Thompson & Spiegelhalter 2009

statement: Absolute risks can be predicted from individually matched case-control sets by fitting conditional logistic regression and adding the log of the control sampling fraction to the model's intercept, which recalibrates the sample's odds to the population's.
regime: individually matched case-control study, predicting absolute risk
decision: absolute risk prediction from a matched case-control design

statement: A bootstrap band whose failed refits are dropped is conditioned on the resamples a model could be fit on; with at least 90% of refits succeeding this barely moves it, but with more failures it describes another population of resamples, so no band is drawn below 90% success.
regime: substitution band with failing refits (e.g. a resample missing a class)
claimed_basis: 'A practitioner convention, not a sourced threshold'

statement: An eligibility cut chosen by looking at the outcome is data-driven selection with its own bias, so the eligibility question withholds the outcome's distribution and a custom range never applies to the outcome.
Under Predict, a highly collinear predictor pair always warrants a decision by the user (a penalty fit inside each fold), so the collinear line is a Decide regardless of materiality.
regime: Predict; explore pair scan finds |r| ≥ 0.9 pairs.
decision: Label of the collinear line under Predict.
claimed_basis: None stated beyond the docstring: "Under Predict the pair scan's lever (a penalty in each fold) is a decision: Decide."
